column1: # Petit chiffre of the Pignerol governors, 1690-91 (Louvois -> d'Herleville 6 Sept 1690; Feuquieres -> Catinat 25 Jan 1691).
# Recovered 2026-09-16 from the printed traduction of the d'Herleville letter (Memoires de Catinat 1819, t. I pp. 140-142)
# and the internal consistency of both letters.  Columns: group, unit, occurrences (both letters), confidence.
# u/v and i/j are one letter (as in the Grand Chiffre).  "_" = null / point.  "?" after a unit = plausible reading, not confirmed by a second context.
# 14 Nov 2026 (verification): 241 vous? -> me (three contexts: "que je me disposois", "que vous me demandez", "dont l'un me conduit");
# added 54 po and 257 so ("dis-po-so-is"), 194 null ("ce _ cy"), 333 et (before "l'autre"; "tout prest, et qu'on"), 353 par ("J'attaqueray par deux endrois").
